historical_boundary: V1 and V2 named fermion/boson occupation, the two-turn spinor, the shared boson ground orbit and Bose-Einstein condensation as observational targets. V3 independently generated and officially admitted Claim 045, including its complete 256-form census, before this measurement vector was assembled. The external records can test the sealed result but cannot alter its survivor.
